configurePresets.name: base
configurePresets.description: DRAFT, not yet used by any CI job. Mirrors what CI/CD sets via environment variables today; see agent_space/ci-preset-inventory.md for the mapping. Sets neither generator nor binaryDir on purpose: scikit-build-core supplies -B and resolves the generator without reading presets, so either would desync its build-type handling. Entries in environment blocks are variables whose CMake consumers still read $ENV{} rather than a cache variable; they move to cacheVariables once fixed. This preset is otherwise empty so a leaf is the only thing constraining a build.

configurePresets.name: ci
configurePresets.description: Context mixin: pull/trunk CI builds. WERROR is NOT here: Linux and macOS CI set it, Windows CI does not, so it sits on the leaves that actually want it.

configurePresets.name: cd
configurePresets.description: Context mixin: binary/nightly CD builds.

configurePresets.name: cpu
configurePresets.description: Variant mixin: CPU-only. Linux pull CI never sets this today and relies on the image lacking CUDA.

configurePresets.name: cuda
configurePresets.description: Variant mixin: CUDA. Only what is genuinely platform-neutral -- Windows CD sets nothing beyond this plus an arch list.

configurePresets.name: cuda-linux-cd
configurePresets.description: The Linux CD CUDA block (CUDA_BUILD_ENV_STATIC in .ci/manywheel/build_env_setup.py). Hardcodes /usr/local/cuda paths, so it must not reach Windows leaves.

configurePresets.name: rocm
configurePresets.description: Variant mixin: ROCm. USE_CUDA is deliberately not set, matching current CI. PYTORCH_ROCM_ARCH comes from the builder image and cannot be pinned here.

configurePresets.name: xpu
configurePresets.description: Variant mixin: XPU. The oneAPI vars.sh environment diff is runtime-captured and cannot live here.

configurePresets.name: linux
configurePresets.description: Platform mixin: Linux x86_64. MKL paths are probed on /opt/intel existing.

configurePresets.name: linux-aarch64
configurePresets.description: Platform mixin: Linux aarch64. No MKL paths; gold linker forced off.

configurePresets.name: linux-s390x
configurePresets.description: Platform mixin: Linux s390x, the only user of the legacy .ci/manywheel shell path.

configurePresets.name: windows
configurePresets.description: Platform mixin: Windows x64. Generator and CC/CXX come from pyproject.toml, not from here.

configurePresets.name: windows-arm64
configurePresets.description: Platform mixin: Windows arm64. BLAS is selected by the bootstrap scripts via ENABLE_APL/ENABLE_OPENBLAS; APL is the CI default.

configurePresets.name: macos-arm64
configurePresets.description: Platform mixin: macOS arm64.

configurePresets.name: linux-cd-cpu
configurePresets.description: manywheel linux cpu (DESIRED_CUDA=cpu). Also covers cpu-cxx11-abi, which has no distinguishing build config.

configurePresets.name: linux-cd-cpu-aarch64
configurePresets.description: manywheel linux cpu-aarch64.

configurePresets.name: linux-cd-cpu-s390x
configurePresets.description: manywheel linux cpu-s390x. Gold linker is ON here because DESIRED_CUDA=cpu and the aarch64 override does not apply.

configurePresets.name: linux-cd-cuda-12_6
configurePresets.description: manywheel linux cu126.

configurePresets.name: linux-cd-cuda-13_0
configurePresets.description: manywheel linux cu130. Nightly builds append +PTX to the 12.0 entry; that is version-dependent and stays dynamic.

configurePresets.name: linux-cd-cuda-13_2
configurePresets.description: manywheel linux cu132. Identical build config to cu130.

configurePresets.name: linux-cd-cuda-12_6-aarch64
configurePresets.description: manywheel linux cuda-aarch64 cu126.

configurePresets.name: linux-cd-cuda-13_0-aarch64
configurePresets.description: manywheel linux cuda-aarch64 cu130.

configurePresets.name: linux-cd-cuda-13_2-aarch64
configurePresets.description: manywheel linux cuda-aarch64 cu132. Identical build config to cu130-aarch64.

configurePresets.name: linux-cd-rocm-7_1
configurePresets.description: manywheel linux rocm7.1. PYTORCH_ROCM_ARCH is supplied by the builder image.

configurePresets.name: linux-cd-rocm-7_2
configurePresets.description: manywheel linux rocm7.2. PYTORCH_ROCM_ARCH is supplied by the builder image.

configurePresets.name: linux-cd-xpu
configurePresets.description: manywheel linux xpu. No arch-list restriction, unlike pull CI.

configurePresets.name: windows-cd-cpu
configurePresets.description: windows binary wheel cpu. sccache is wired as CC/CXX=sccache-cl outside the preset.

configurePresets.name: windows-cd-cuda-12_6
configurePresets.description: windows binary wheel cu126.

configurePresets.name: windows-cd-cuda-13_0
configurePresets.description: windows binary wheel cu130.

configurePresets.name: windows-cd-cuda-13_2
configurePresets.description: windows binary wheel cu132. Identical build config to cu130.

configurePresets.name: windows-cd-xpu
configurePresets.description: windows binary wheel xpu. No sccache on this path.

configurePresets.name: windows-arm64-cd-cpu
configurePresets.description: windows arm64 binary wheel. Note the script sets CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE from an unset BUILD_TYPE today, so Release is reached by accident.

configurePresets.name: macos-arm64-cd-cpu
configurePresets.description: macOS arm64 binary wheel. No sccache on this path.

configurePresets.name: linux-ci-cpu
configurePresets.description: pull/trunk linux CPU build.

configurePresets.name: linux-ci-cuda
configurePresets.description: pull/trunk linux CUDA build. TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST is per-job (workflow input, default 7.5) so it is deliberately not pinned here.

configurePresets.name: linux-ci-aarch64
configurePresets.description: pull/trunk linux aarch64 build. Unlike CD, BLAS is auto-detected.

configurePresets.name: linux-ci-rocm
configurePresets.description: pull/trunk linux ROCm build. CI appends ;gfx1033 to the image's PYTORCH_ROCM_ARCH, which stays dynamic.

configurePresets.name: linux-ci-xpu
configurePresets.description: pull/trunk linux XPU build (pvc). The *client* jobs use bmg instead.

configurePresets.name: linux-ci-xpu-client
configurePresets.description: pull/trunk linux XPU client build.

configurePresets.name: windows-ci-cpu
configurePresets.description: pull/trunk windows CPU build. WERROR is not set on Windows CI.

configurePresets.name: windows-ci-cuda
configurePresets.description: pull/trunk windows CUDA build. The nvcc launcher chain (randomtemp + sccache) is runtime-pathed and stays outside the preset.

configurePresets.name: windows-ci-xpu
configurePresets.description: pull/trunk windows XPU build.

configurePresets.name: windows-arm64-ci
configurePresets.description: pull/trunk windows arm64 build. CMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM is set only on this path.

configurePresets.name: macos-arm64-ci
configurePresets.description: pull/trunk macOS arm64 build. Sets USE_PYTORCH_METAL (documented as the iOS flag) where CD sets USE_PYTORCH_METAL_EXPORT; see inventory divergence 3.

configurePresets.name: macos-arm64-ci-distributed
configurePresets.description: pull/trunk macOS arm64 distributed build (inductor-perf-test-nightly-macos).
